title: Rahoton Rarraba Irin Shuka na Damina 2026

headings.text: Rahoton Rarraba Irin Shuka na Damina 2026

key_sentences: An rarraba irin shuka ga manoma ɗari biyar da arba'in a ƙauyuka uku na ƙaramar hukuma.
Kowane manomi ya karɓi iri bisa ga girman gonarsa da kuma irin amfanin gonar da yake nomawa.
Ruwan sama ya fara da wuri a bana, saboda haka an kammala rarrabawa kafin ƙarshen watan Yuni.
Wasu manoma ba su samu irin gyaɗa ba saboda ƙarancin kaya a rumbun ajiya.
Muna godiya ga shugabannin ƙauyuka da masu taimaka wa aikin gona bisa haɗin kai da suka ba mu.

list_items.text: Ƙarancin irin gyaɗa a rumbun ajiya
Lalacewar hanyar zuwa Rafin Gora bayan ruwan sama na farko
Jinkirin isowar motar kaya daga cibiyar jiha
1) A ƙara yawan irin gyaɗa da kashi talatin a shekara mai zuwa.
2) A fara rarrabawa a watan Mayu kafin hanyoyi su lalace.
3) A horar da masu taimaka wa aikin gona kan adana iri a ƙauyuka.
